IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldCounterValue') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldCounterValue]( [AssetId] [bigint] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeId] [int] NOT NULL, [FieldTypeId] [int] NOT NULL, [Value] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [UQ_FieldCounterAssetMapping] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [AssetId] ASC, [FieldTypeId] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY], CONSTRAINT [UQ_FieldCounterValue] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [FieldTypeId] ASC, [Value] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY]
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldCounterValue] ON [dbo].[FieldCounterValue] ( [AssetId] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, DROP_EXISTING = OFF, ONLINE = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] END

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FieldCounterValue_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[FieldCounterValue] INSTEAD OF INSERT, UPDATE AS BEGIN
declare @currentFieldTypeId int
drop table if exists #fieldTypeIds select distinct fieldtypeid into #fieldTypeIds from inserted
while exists (select 1 from #fieldTypeIds) begin set @currentFieldTypeId = (select top 1 * from #fieldTypeIds) declare @lastIndex int = (select top 1 [Value] from dbo.FieldCounterValue where FieldTypeId = @currentFieldTypeId order by [Value] desc) + 1 declare @initialIndex int = (select top 1 CounterInitialIndex from FieldType where ID = @currentFieldTypeId)
if @lastIndex is null or @initialIndex > @lastIndex begin set @lastIndex = @initialIndex end
if @lastIndex is null begin set @lastIndex = (select count(*) from fieldtype ft inner join AssetType at on at.Object = ft.object and at.objectid = ft.objectid inner join Asset A on a.assettypeid = at.id where ft.id = @currentFieldTypeId) end
drop table if exists #indexMap
select i.*, Row_number() Over(Order by assetid) + @lastIndex as 'IndexValue' into #indexMap from inserted i where fieldtypeid = @currentFieldTypeId
drop table if exists #indexList create table #indexList([SEQUENCE] int)
declare @start int = @lastIndex declare @end int = @start + (select count(*) from #indexMap)
insert into #indexList select top (select count(*) from #indexMap) ROW_NUMBER() over(order by a.assetid) + (@start-1) as [SEQUENCE] from inserted a
drop table if exists #toInsert
create table #toInsert(assetid int, assettypeid int, fieldtypeid int, value int)
insert into #toInsert select * from inserted where value is not null and fieldtypeid = @currentFieldTypeId
delete from #indexList where [SEQUENCE] in (select value from #toInsert)
;with index_cte as ( select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [SEQUENCE]) as RowNumber from #indexList ), [data] as ( select *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AssetId) as RowNumber from inserted where value is null and fieldtypeid = @currentFieldTypeId ) insert into #toInsert select assetid, assettypeid, fieldtypeid, cte.SEQUENCE as Value from [data] inner join index_cte cte on cte.RowNumber = [data].RowNumber
select * from #toInsert
MERGE dbo.FieldCounterValue T using (select * from #toInsert) S ON T.AssetId = S.AssetId and T.FieldTypeId = S.FieldTypeId WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.Value = S.Value WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (AssetId,AssetTypeId,FieldTypeId, Value) values (S.AssetID,S.AssetTypeId, s.FieldTypeId, s.Value);
delete top (1) from #fieldTypeIds end
END
